flat_residents_verified_fields.name: flat_residents_verified_fields
flat_residents_verified_fields.value: ("flat_residents"."verification_status" = 'VERIFIED') = ("flat_residents"."verified_at" is not null and "flat_residents"."verified_by" is not null)

generated.as: case when btrim(coalesce(parking_slots, '')) = '' then 0 else array_length(string_to_array(parking_slots, ','), 1) end

flats_sharing_capacity.name: flats_sharing_capacity
flats_sharing_capacity.value: case when "flats"."sharing_allowed" then "flats"."max_occupants" is null or "flats"."max_occupants" >= 2 else "flats"."max_occupants" is null end

staff_entry_rejections_other_needs_note.name: staff_entry_rejections_other_needs_note
staff_entry_rejections_other_needs_note.value: "staff_entry_rejections"."reason" <> 'OTHER' or ("staff_entry_rejections"."note" is not null and btrim("staff_entry_rejections"."note") <> '')

users_login_identifier_present.name: users_login_identifier_present
users_login_identifier_present.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null

visits_exit_after_entry.name: visits_exit_after_entry
visits_exit_after_entry.value: "visits"."exited_at" is null or ("visits"."entered_at" is not null and "visits"."exited_at" >= "visits"."entered_at")
